title: Sign changes in a series
description: Count how many times the sign flips along a series of integers. Zeros have no sign and are skipped: compare each non-zero value with the closest non-zero value before it, so that [3, 0, -2] has one flip and [3, 0, 5] has none. Positive followed by negative, or negative followed by positive, is one flip. A series with no or one non-zero value has 0 flips.
notes: Zeros must not reset the remembered sign (flip across zeros counts) and must not count as a sign themselves. Needs a carried last non-zero sign.
